title: Lemon and Coriander Hummus
description: This hummus is fresh and zingy with lemon, making it the perfect dip for veggie sticks. We use butter beans to both reduce calories and give a creamier, less gritty texture than making it with chickpeas.

ingredients.text: 25g bunch of coriander, leaves only, plus extra leaves to serve
zest and juice of 1 lemon, plus
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps:
Roughly chop the coriander leaves. Add half of the coriander to a blender
with the butter beans, natural yoghurt, lemon juice and zest, garlic
granules and a pinch each of salt and pepper. Blitz until coarsely
blended, then stir in the other half of the coriander.
Serve, garnished with lemon slices and more coriander leaves.
